subject: Partner-led Discovery: Redwood x CloudBridge — next steps & technical deep dive
messages:
From: CloudBridge Partnerships <partners@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit@cloudbridge.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Partner-led Discovery: Redwood x CloudBridge — next steps

Hi Marissa / Mateo,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: we discussed integration surface for Redwood in CloudBridge marketplace (listing, onboarding flow), security requirements (SAML / audit logs), and performance expectations for inference workloads.
- Action items: CloudBridge to share marketplace integration checklist; Redwood to surface recommended runtime config and any marketplace-specific packaging notes.

We'd like to schedule a technical deep dive / demo next week to align engineering teams and run through a short checklist: packaging, API/networking, and pre-prod validation plan. Proposed slots (all PDT):
  - Thu 2026-10-15, 10:00–11:00 AM
  - Fri 2026-10-16, 1:00–2:00 PM

Who from your side should join? On our side Mateo will cover runtime and deployment details; I'll join to coordinate marketplace steps.

Attached: CloudBridge-Redwood-Discovery-Deck.pdf (summary + marketplace checklist), CloudBridge-Architecture-Diagram.png (high level).

If those times don't work, feel free to drop a link to a couple alternatives (here's my Calendly: https://calendly.com/amit-cloudbridge/redwood).

Thanks,
Amit Shah
Partner Lead, CloudBridge
partners@cloudbridge.com

Attachments: CloudBridge-Redwood-Discovery-Deck.pdf (application/pdf); CloudBridge-Architecture-Diagram.png (image/png)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: CloudBridge Partnerships <partners@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner-led Discovery: Redwood x CloudBridge — next steps

Amit — thanks for the recap and the deck. Appreciate the clear checklist.

Both slots look good for us. Mateo and I prefer Thu 10/15 10:00 AM PDT if that works for your engineering lead. I'll block the time tentatively and share a calendar invite once you confirm.

Attendees from Redwood:
- Marissa Cole — Partner Manager
- Mateo Alvarez — Solutions Engineer (runtime + infra)
- (optional) Marcus Lin — Marketplace Ops (if we need to review listing specifics)

Prep asks from our side: if you can share the marketplace integration checklist in a doc (or point to the drive link) and any network/firewall IP ranges for pre-prod, that would help Mateo scope the demo. Also please confirm who your infra/engineering lead will be so we can include them in the invite.

I'll include a proposed agenda in the invite: 10m intros, 25m technical demo (runtime + packaging), 15m integration checklist and next actions, 10m Q&A.

Calendly link (if you want to re-time): https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/redwood-cloudbridge-demo

Best,
Marissa Cole
Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

--
